name: live-durable-recovery-ack
detail: A real queued wake resurfaced once, survived a second quiet checkpoint unchanged, and was removed only by the drain acknowledgement printed by the product.

name: live-checkpoint-signal
detail: Writing a real status file closed the foreground checkpoint with one signal line, exit 0, and a durable wake row.

name: live-interrupted-startup
detail: Interrupted real startup returned failure in 2.79s (1s checkpoint plus 2s cleanup, below the 5s kill grace), retained the identity-bound lock, and never published a beacon.

name: live-owned-stall
detail: The real owned arm returned nonzero for a watcher stalled on the recovery lock, printed the already-delivered signal exactly once, and retained the durable queue byte for byte.

name: live-attached-stall
detail: The real attached arm returned nonzero for a watcher stalled on the recovery lock, printed the already-delivered signal exactly once, and retained the durable queue byte for byte.
